title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A dynamic full-body illustration of a female warrior with purple hair leaping forward. She wields a massive purple warhammer with glowing crackling patterns in her right hand while her left fist is clenched and extended, wearing white and purple battle attire with armored gauntlets and greaves.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with short purple hair is captured mid-leap in a dynamic action pose against a solid gray background. She holds a large purple warhammer with glowing crackle patterns in her right hand and has her left fist clenched forward. She wears a white and purple cropped battle outfit with armored gauntlets, leg guards, and boots. Comic book style digital illustration with bold outlines and vibrant colors.
